lessons.title: Basic Greetings and Phrases
lessons.description: Learn common Sanskrit greetings and expressions

lessons.title: Numbers 1-10 in Sanskrit
lessons.description: Learn to count in Sanskrit

quiz.question: What is the Sanskrit word for 5?

lessons.title: Self Introduction in Sanskrit
lessons.description: Learn to introduce yourself - name, age, profession, and where you live

quiz.question: How do you say 'My name is Rama' in Sanskrit?
quiz.explanation: 'मम नाम' means 'my name', 'रामः' is Rama, 'अस्ति' means 'is'

quiz.question: What is the correct translation of 'I am 25 years old'?
quiz.explanation: 'मम वयः' means 'my age', 'पञ्चविंशति' is 25, 'वर्षाणि सन्ति' means 'years are'

quiz.question: How do you say 'I am a student' in Sanskrit?
What is 'I live in Mumbai' in Sanskrit?
quiz.explanation: 'अहं' means 'I', 'मुम्बई नगरे' means 'in Mumbai city', 'वसामि' means 'live'

quiz.question: How would you say 'Nice to meet you'?
quiz.explanation: This phrase literally means 'Meeting with you is pleasant'

lessons.title: Basic Pronouns
lessons.description: Learn the most common Sanskrit pronouns and their gendered forms

lessons.title: Basic Action Words (Verbs)
lessons.description: Learn the 10 most common daily actions and how to use them with pronouns

lessons.title: Nouns & Genders (Sorting)
lessons.description: Learn the secret 'cheat code' to identify Sanskrit genders and master word classifications.

lessons.title: Family & Relationships (कुटुम्बः)
lessons.description: Learn Sanskrit words for family members with an interactive family tree map.

lessons.title: Question Words (प्रश्नपदानि)
lessons.description: Master the 8 essential Sanskrit question words through an interactive chatbot interrogation game.

lessons.title: Time & Days (समयः वासरः च)
lessons.description: Learn to tell the time in Sanskrit with an interactive draggable clock and master the days of the week through a timeline puzzle.

lessons.title: Vibhakti – The 7 Cases
lessons.description: Master the 7 grammatical cases (Nominative, Accusative, Instrumental, Dative, Ablative, Genitive, Locative) with declension tables and practice exercises.

lessons.title: Sandhi – Euphonic Combinations
lessons.description: Learn how sounds merge when words combine. Master Vowel Sandhi, Visarga Sandhi, and Consonant Sandhi rules for flawless Sanskrit pronunciation and writing.

lessons.title: Verb Tenses – Past & Future
lessons.description: Expand your verb knowledge beyond the present tense. Learn the past (Imperfect) and future tenses to describe actions across time.

lessons.title: Verb Moods – Imperative & Optative
lessons.description: Learn how to give commands (Imperative), make polite requests, express wishes, and talk about possibilities (Optative) in Sanskrit.

lessons.title: Pronouns – Dual & Plural Forms
lessons.description: Master the complete pronoun system: learn dual (for two persons) and plural forms for first, second, and third persons, plus demonstrative pronouns in all numbers and genders.

lessons.title: Upasarga – Verbal Prefixes
lessons.description: Master the 20+ verbal prefixes (उपसर्ग) that modify and enrich verb meanings. Learn how prefixes like प्र, परा, अप, सम् transform basic verbs into new words.

lessons.title: Active & Passive Voice
lessons.description: Learn how to transform sentences between active and passive voice in Sanskrit. Master karmaṇi prayoga (passive construction) and bhāve prayoga (impersonal passive).

lessons.title: Indeclinables (अव्यय)
lessons.description: Master the words that never change form. Learn conjunctions (च, वा), adverbs (अत्र, कुत्र), particles (अपि, एव), prepositions, and interjections essential for fluent Sanskrit.

lessons.title: Participles – Part 1 (कृत् प्रत्यय)
lessons.description: Learn the essential participle forms: Past Passive Participle (क्त), Future Passive Participle (तव्य/अनीयर्), and Gerund (क्त्वा). These are crucial for expressing completed actions, obligations, and sequential actions.

lessons.title: Reading & Composition
lessons.description: Apply all your Sanskrit knowledge! Read short passages with comprehension questions, expand your vocabulary, and practice writing paragraphs on given topics.
